scope: Independent read-only review of all three Reviewer 6 comments and their subrequests; abstract/introduction/discussion/conclusion coherence; supporting saved numerical outputs.
interpretation: Addressed means the request is answered with evidence or an explicit scope restriction; partial means a substantive limitation remains. It is not a prediction of acceptance.

comments.topic: Methodological novelty, simulation/experimental validation, and modest pooled-corrected topology effects

subrequests.request: Demonstrate a fundamentally new methodology rather than combining established construction, synchronization, representation and persistence methods.
subrequests.residual_gap: The revision identifies a controlled comparative contribution, not a new estimator or established novel architecture. That reframing is scientifically defensible but does not satisfy a demand for fundamental methodological novelty by itself.

subrequests.request: Explain the theoretical or methodological advance relevant to EEG emotion analysis.
subrequests.residual_gap: The specific advance is separating representation semantics, shared-signal associations and generalization targets in a reproducible comparison. No theorem, uniquely nonlinear neural mechanism or general fusion advantage is established. No new such claim should be invented.

Simulations and phase surrogates exist and their role is stated. Decoder simulations are calibrated to full FACED data and examine selected noise structures; they do not independently validate the original one-second findings or physiological specificity. One surrogate per trial is a descriptive reference, not a repeated-dataset null distribution.

Independent cohort/laboratory assessment is supplied, but is neither a new controlled experiment nor successful replication of scalar-topology contrasts. The models are trained separately in each dataset, not transferred without retraining. Table S1 should say independent assessment consistently.

subrequests.request: Resolve the specific finding that no scalar topology contrast survives pooled correction across 144 tests.
subrequests.residual_gap: No numerical resolution is claimed: the original pooled null result is preserved, with the single within-representation QG finding clearly distinguished. This corrects interpretation rather than converting an unconfirmed contrast into a supported marker.

subrequests.request: Support claims of emotion-dependent network reorganization in view of weak scalar effects.
subrequests.residual_gap: Distributed participant-level subnetworks and descriptive centroid summaries support representation-specific organization of the sampled affective video conditions. They do not establish stimulus-general emotion-specific network reorganization. Current main text explicitly distinguishes those scopes.

comments.topic: Correlational interpretation, emotion-specific mechanisms, and dependence on mathematical representations

subrequests.request: Recognize that synchronization differences and synchronization-topology relations are correlational.
subrequests.residual_gap: The paper now uses association/covariation and does not assert causality. This is a correct scope restriction, not an identification of mechanism.

subrequests.request: Establish whether the effects are robust emotion-specific neural mechanisms.
subrequests.residual_gap: Mechanisms remain unestablished. Category labels remain coupled to audiovisual/narrative content, and the temporal/EMG/session controls do not isolate subjective emotion. The response appropriately declines to infer such mechanisms; no extra analysis is represented as proof.

subrequests.request: Separate characteristics of selected mathematical representations from neurophysiological interpretation.
subrequests.residual_gap: Node semantics, fixed graph construction, shared signal structure, and pairwise-derived homology are distinguished. Calling a transformation nonlinear does not itself test nonlinear generating dynamics; no such successful test is claimed in the conclusions.

subrequests.request: Validate robustness of the reported main synchronization-topology associations.
subrequests.residual_gap: The added surrogate and non-overlapping-window controls concern 30-s/15-s mixed-model estimates; the main findings concern one-second clustered-OLS estimates. The response now explicitly acknowledges that these controls inform interpretation but do not directly validate one-second physiological specificity.

comments.topic: Baselines, statistical controls, robustness, independent validation, reproducibility and comparative contribution

subrequests.residual_gap: Linear, MLP, no-graph/random/biological graph and matched EEGNet/auxiliary-shuffle baselines exist. Participant-held-out identical-input comparisons use inherited neural training settings; they are not exhaustively optimized comparisons of every literature model.

Multiplicity, stimulus-aware inference, model-specific full-refit nulls, graph controls and a session-conditional null are supplied. The matched EEGNet tests condition on fitted models and familiar stimuli; nominal data-informed held-video GNN comparisons remain exploratory.

Settings, density, window, seed, EMG-proxy and preprocessing checks are substantial. Most new construction/physiology controls concern 30-s data; augmented EEGNet was not rerun under the improved diagnostic recipe. A universal robustness claim remains unsupported and is not made.

Independent data are analyzed, but scalar effects are unconfirmed and recording/session structure remains material. SEED recurrence is a separate temporal finding; it is not replication of the original one-second topology effects. Only synchronization plus power received the added session-preserving held-source null.

subrequests.request: Demonstrate reproducibility of the reported findings.
subrequests.residual_gap: The new release includes substantial scripts, configurations, retained outputs and independent checks. S24 historical generator is unavailable and a physics-informed variant is summary-only, as disclosed. The SEED subdirectory README retains a stale main-Results reference and does not distinguish initial versus strictly nested source summary counts; proposed documentation edits below close this small remaining provenance gap.

subrequests.request: Demonstrate meaningful outperformance of existing EEG network-analysis approaches.
subrequests.residual_gap: No general superiority is established. LDA is strongest observed in FACED identical-input participant tests; graph priors do not establish benefit; EEGNet augmentation gains are window-, seed- and preprocessing-dependent. Non-significant differences do not establish equivalence. The paper and response correctly present a comparative evaluation rather than a best-performing method.

subrequests.request: Resolve the overall concern that methodological innovation and empirical support do not sustain the original main claims.
subrequests.residual_gap: The original main text is retained with narrower condition-specific descriptive claims and controls in the supplement. The scientific case is more transparent, but prose and added model count cannot ensure that the reviewer accepts its novelty. This is a remaining scientific/editorial judgment, not an unaddressed comment or a reason to invent new results.

strongest_supported_contribution: A controlled comparison of complementary sensor-space and amplitude-state EEG representations that separates descriptive condition differences, shared-signal synchronization-topology associations, and prediction under explicit participant/stimulus generalization targets.

whole_paper_coherence.abstract_and_conclusion: consistent with exploratory video-condition scope and modest scalar topology evidence
whole_paper_coherence.nonlinear_interpretation: Nonlinear transformations and recurrence descriptors are used; no identified nonlinear generator or emotion-specific neural mechanism is demonstrated.
whole_paper_coherence.independent_dataset: Independent assessment is appropriate. Change Table S1 status and stale release README; do not call separate model fits cross-dataset transfer.
whole_paper_coherence.comparative_performance: No general architectural superiority or equivalence; conditional EEGNet gains and linear baselines are reported with material limitations.
